about_the_game:
The cool and mysterious virtual singer Megurine Luka is now available on Desktop Mate! You can purchase her as downloadable content (DLC) on Desktop Mate. Enjoy the cool and slightly mysterious charm of Megurine Luka on Desktop Mate with a completely new 3D model created exclusively for this purpose.

  • Beautiful graphics and natural movements powered by the latest 3D technology

  • 3D models created exclusively for Desktop Mate

  • Includes exclusive voices and original motions

* Desktop Mate is required to use this content. Please update to the latest version before use. * This content must be used in accordance with the “PIAPRO CHARACTER LICENSE”.

* According to this license, this content may be used for video distribution on platforms such as YouTube, NicoNico Douga, and Twitch.

Contents included in this product

Megurine Luka
